title: World Generation Configuration (world_gen.json)
description: Schema for the top-level world generation configuration. A single JSON file at project root that drives how new worlds are seeded: planet geometry per ADR-0010 (Goldberg sim overlay) and ADR-0017 (cube-sphere voxel substrate), biome distribution, sub_faction instantiation per ADR-0014, Pentagon Site assignment, and player spawn placement.

planet.description: Planet geometry. Per ADR-0017, the planet has a dual structure: a cube-sphere voxel substrate where blocks live, and a Goldberg hex-sphere sim overlay where sub_factions and biomes are scoped. The two are rotated so 8 cube corners coincide with 8 of 12 Goldberg pentagons (creating 12 Pentagon Sites).

sim_overlay.description: Goldberg hex-sphere parameters (sim overlay) per ADR-0010 amended by ADR-0017. MVP default is G(4,0).

voxel_substrate.description: Cube-sphere voxel substrate parameters per ADR-0017.

projection.description: Cube-to-sphere projection. ASC (Adjusted Spherical Cube, Dimitrijević 2016) is the recommended default; spherified_cube is the simpler Catlike-Coding formula; cobe_qsc is the equal-area NASA projection.

shell_count.description: Number of concentric voxel shells from the surface to the core. Each shell subdivides toward the center to keep voxel proportions reasonable.

min_core_voxel_size_meters.description: Minimum voxel edge length at the innermost shell. Below this depth the core is hollow.

radius_meters.description: Planet radius. ADR-0017 default is 6000 m (~37.7 km circumference, ~7.5 hours to circumnavigate at walking speed). Smaller radii produce more visible cube-edge dihedral kinks; larger radii spread content thin.

pentagon_site_assignment.description: Authored or procgen assignment of the 12 Pentagon Sites (per ADR-0017). 8 Corner Pentagons (cube corners) default to cosmic-horror eruption points; 4 Face-Center Pentagons (cube face centers) default to civilizational seed sites.

corner_pentagons.description: Authored overrides for the 8 Corner Pentagon assignments. Order corresponds to cube corner ids 0-7. Entries may reference cosmic-horror site templates or be left blank for procgen default.

face_center_pentagons.description: Authored overrides for the 4 Face-Center Pentagon assignments. cube_face_id is one of the 6 cube faces (0-5); only 4 of 6 have pentagon coincidence (the other 2 are unmarked).

default_seed.description: Default seed string for new worlds. Players may override at world creation. The seed deterministically produces the same world (same tile assignments, same sub_faction placements, same procgen NPCs) given the same Manifest version.

biome_assignment.description: How biomes are assigned to hex tiles.

strategy.description: latitude_climate: biomes follow climate bands by latitude with noise variation. voronoi_seed: biome seeds placed and tiles assigned to nearest seed. noise_based: pure noise function. manual: tiles assigned in this file.

climate_band_breakpoints.description: Latitude breakpoints in degrees (from equator at 0 to pole at 90) defining climate transitions.

biome_pool.description: Biomes available for placement on this planet.

sub_faction_generation.description: How sub_factions are instantiated at world gen. Combines authored sub_factions (always placed) with procgen instances from templates.

authored_sub_factions.description: Authored sub_faction URNs to place at world generation. Each is required to exist at world start.

procgen_sub_factions.description: SubFaction templates to instantiate. Counts and placement rules per template.

count_override.description: Optional. Overrides the template's own count_at_world_gen.

unclaimed_tile_target_fraction.description: Approximate fraction of total tiles to leave unclaimed by any sub_faction. Reserved for wilderness and cosmic-horror sites.

pentagon_seeding.description: Per ADR-0018. Controls how the 12 Pentagon Sites are filled at world generation by sampling from the available culture pool, constrained by per-culture pentagon_eligibility declarations. Authored pinnings in planet.pentagon_site_assignment take precedence; this block governs procgen for the remaining Pentagon slots.

face_center_pool_strategy.description: How to fill Face-Center Pentagons. founding_only: sample only from cultures tagged 'founding'; emit warning if pool < 4 and leave excess slots as wilderness Wonder Regions. founding_with_ruined_fallback: prefer 'founding' cultures, fall back to 'ruined' tagged cultures (creating world-start ruins) when the founding pool is exhausted. ruined_only: every Face-Center Pentagon is a fallen sub_faction ruin.

corner_pool_strategy.description: How to fill Corner Pentagons. corrupt_only: sample only from cultures tagged 'corrupt'; emit warning if pool < 8 and leave excess slots as unanchored procedural cosmic-horror sites. corrupt_with_procgen_fallback: use 'corrupt' cultures where available, generate procedural cosmic-horror sites (no anchored culture) for the rest.

pentagon_overrides.description: Optional hard-pinned culture assignments for specific Pentagon Sites. Overrides the procgen sampling for the named Pentagon. Pentagon ids: 'corner_0' through 'corner_7' for Corner Pentagons; 'face_center_0' through 'face_center_3' for Face-Center Pentagons. These take precedence over the pool strategies. Equivalent functionality to planet.pentagon_site_assignment entries; either may be used.

culture.description: Culture URN to seed at this Pentagon Site. Culture must have a pentagon_eligibility compatible with the Pentagon's class (founding/ruined for Face-Center, corrupt for Corner).

max_pentagons_per_culture.description: Maximum number of Pentagon Sites a single culture may seed at via procgen sampling in one world. Prevents one culture from claiming all four Face-Center Pentagons by accident in a small pool. Authored overrides bypass this constraint.

cosmic_horror_sites.description: Placement of cosmic-horror manifestation locations. Per the design constraint that cosmic horror is part of the world (placement still being grilled).

placement_preferences.description: Tile selection biases for cosmic-horror sites.

min_distance_from_sub_faction_tiles.description: Minimum tile-graph distance from any sub_faction-owned tile. Higher values keep horrors away from civilization at world start.

player_spawn.description: Configuration for the player character's initial position and inventory. The player's sub_faction (typically the crash-site camp per the flagship's design) handles its own tile placement via the sub_faction's initial_tile_assignment; this section is about the player CHARACTER within that sub_faction, not the sub_faction itself.

sub_faction.description: URN of the authored sub_faction the player starts in. Must be present in sub_faction_generation.authored_sub_factions.

spawn_tile_selection.description: How to pick a specific tile within the sub_faction for player spawn.

starting_inventory.description: Items the player has at world start. Distinct from the sub_faction's stored resources.

weather_globals.description: Global weather parameters. Per-biome weather patterns override at the tile level.

blood_moon_period_days.description: Game days between blood moon events. Zero disables.

cargo_manifest.description: Per the Project Halcyon design doc. The Resonance Web artifacts that were aboard the Halcyon at the time of crash, per-playthrough procgen. The cargo manifest itself is split between artifacts the player recovers from wreckage-archaeology and artifacts that were planet-native (placed in pre-history by the Architectural Age). Heart-Class artifacts are constrained to canonical seven-of-seven; lower classes are budgeted by ranges.

total_artifact_count_range.description: Total artifacts placed in the world per playthrough across all classes and pools. Design doc range: ~12 to ~25.

heart_class_split.description: Heart-Class artifacts are always seven total across the playthrough. This block governs the cargo-vs-planet split.

cargo_count_range.description: Number of Heart-Class artifacts placed in the Halcyon's recoverable cargo manifest. Design doc range: 3 to 4 of the seven.

planet_native_count_range.description: Number of Heart-Class artifacts placed as planet-native (held by Sub-Factions, bosses, or geographic features). Design doc range: 3 to 4 of the seven. Sum of cargo and planet-native must equal 7.

tier_locked_artifacts.description: Heart-Class artifact URNs that bypass the cargo/planet split because their placement_pool is tier_locked (notably the Prime Array). These are placed by their tier_lock criteria rather than counted against the split.

wreckage_recovery_curve.description: How cargo artifacts surface to the player. The Halcyon's data systems progressively reveal what was being carried as the player restores them; in-cargo artifacts are not all immediately known or accessible. This governs the discovery pacing.

act_3_known_fraction.description: Fraction of cargo artifacts known to the player by end of Opening Sequence Act 3. Lower values lean discovery into mid-game.

mid_game_known_fraction.description: Fraction of cargo artifacts known by mid-game (rough Storyteller tier 2-3 progression).
